conflicts_resolved: Advisor line wording: uhnw wanted 'confirms what the venue will supply' instead of 'inclusions'; planner_couple (primary) and funding_parent praised the line as is. Kept 'inclusions' (brand-facts wording); only the unsupported second clause is cut.

Remote mock-up: planner_couple (primary) wanted the Advisor to review photos with them. brand-facts.md does not support that, so the fix points the couple to the checklist instead; the close no longer implies the Advisor handles the mock-up.

Order of decisions: sceptic valued 'venue stock first' as cost-aware, uhnw read it as making do. The primary persona's hidden-cost fear favours keeping the order, so the order stays and only the wording softens.

Intro: search_visitor and sceptic found the first paragraph slow; planner_couple (primary) called it calm and grown-up and uhnw praised the first line. Paragraph 1 kept; paragraph 2 signposts the themes.

Hire follow-up: funding_parent wanted who books, pays and carries the risk; sceptic wanted per-piece costs. Both deferred or price-bound. Resolved with the primary persona's plain question 'what would that add to the quote?', which states nothing.

checks.check: Weighted maths uses all five weights (sum 1.0).
Every edit 'old' occurs exactly once in 05-draft-r2.md, and edits apply cleanly in edit_order.
Advisor lines verbatim-faithful to brand-facts.md lines 19 to 30: one body line plus the close; no mock-up, sourcing, hire or on-site implication.
No new facts, measurements, prices, vendor names, 'best', statistics, 'free' (except step-free), 'last dance', em or en dashes in any new text.
Headings: no colon, dash or hyphen, no question outside the FAQ; title, H1, slug and URL untouched; Emily Post credit kept.
Exactly 4 one-sentence takeaways; UTMs once each; body word count 2424 to 2451 by local count (net about +27), inside 1,800 to 2,600 on the caller's count of about 2,520.
